text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in Annex 3, the vehicle shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 6.1.1 to 6.1.5.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the lighting and signalling devices shall remain visible.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: Should the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices be disturbed by the impact, it may be corrected to conform to the required specifications only provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment.
condition: if the adjustment of factory-fitted lighting devices is disturbed by the impact

text: Bulbs of the lighting and signalling devices may be replaced after the impact test in the event of filament failure.
condition: in the event of filament failure

text: After each impact test, the vehicle's bonnet (hood) shall be operable in the normal manner.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the vehicle's boot lid (trunk lid) shall be operable in the normal manner.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the vehicle's doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: The side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.
condition: during each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the vehicle's fuel system shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the vehicle's cooling system shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the sealing devices and caps of the fuel system shall be operable in the normal manner.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the sealing devices and caps of the cooling system shall be operable in the normal manner.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the vehicle's propulsion system shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the vehicle's suspension (including tyres) shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the vehicle's steering system shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: After each impact test, the vehicle's braking system shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.
condition: after each impact test per Annex 3

text: Sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 only as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.
condition: for sensors, cameras, radar devices being part of driver assist systems

text: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.
A sufficient number of random checks shall be made on serially manufactured vehicles bearing the approval mark to verify conformity with the approved type.
As a general rule, the conformity of production checks shall be confined to measurements.
The vehicles shall, if necessary, be subjected to the checks prescribed in paragraph 6.
condition: if necessary

text: If the holder of the approval completely ceases production of a vehicle approved in accordance with this Regulation, he shall so inform the authority which granted the approval.
condition: if production is definitely discontinued

text: Upon receiving the communication of discontinued production, the authority shall inform the other Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a copy of the approval form bearing at the end, in large letters, the signed and dated annotation "PRODUCTION DISCONTINUED".
condition: upon receiving notice of discontinued production

text: The low-speed-impact test shall make it possible to verify whether the protective devices of the vehicle meet the requirements of this Regulation.
The test area shall be large enough to accommodate the impactor (striker) propulsion system and to permit after-impact displacement of the vehicle impacted and installation of the test equipment.
The vehicle shall be placed on a horizontal and level rigid smooth surface.
The vehicle shall be at rest for the impact test.
The front wheels of the vehicle shall be in the straight-ahead position for the impact test.
The tyres shall be inflated to the pressure recommended by the vehicle manufacturer for the impact test.
The brakes shall be disengaged for the impact test.
The transmission control shall be in neutral position for the impact test.

Vehicles equipped with hydropneumatic, hydraulic or pneumatic suspension or a device for automatic levelling according to load shall be tested in the normal running conditions specified by the manufacturer.
condition: if the vehicle is equipped with hydropneumatic, hydraulic or pneumatic suspension or automatic levelling device

text: The impactor shall be of rigid construction, the impact contour being of hardened steel.
The impacting surface of the impactor shall conform to the diagram in the figure.
The effective mass of the impactor shall be equal to the mass corresponding to the unladen weight of the vehicle to be tested.
With plane A of the impactor vertical, the reference line shall be horizontal.
The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.

In both the unladen weight and laden test weight conditions, the protective device between the vehicle corners shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line of the impactor (reference height).
condition: in both vehicle-loading conditions

text: The reference height of the impactor reference line shall be 445 mm.
The impactor shall either be secured to a carriage (moving barrier) or form part of a pendulum.
If the impactor is secured to a carriage (moving barrier) by a restraining element, the restraining element must be rigid and be incapable of being deformed by the impact.
condition: where a moving barrier is used

text: The carriage (moving barrier) shall at the moment of impact be capable of moving freely and no longer be subject to the action of the propelling device.
condition: where a moving barrier is used

text: The distance between the pendulum pivot and the centre of percussion shall be at least 3.3 m.
condition: where a pendulum is used

text: The reference line of the pendulum impactor shall coincide with the centre of percussion.
condition: where a pendulum is used

text: Plane A of the pendulum shall remain parallel with its axis of rotation throughout the test.
condition: where a pendulum is used

text: In the case of a parallelogram-suspended pendulum, the trajectory described by any point on the reference line shall be constant with a radius of at least 3.3 m.
condition: where a parallelogram-suspended pendulum is used

text: The longitudinal impact test shall consist of two impacts on the front surface of the vehicle, one with the vehicle at unladen weight and one at laden test weight.
The longitudinal impact test shall consist of two impacts on the rear surface of the vehicle, one with the vehicle at unladen weight and one at laden test weight.

For the longitudinal impacts on the front and rear surfaces, the median plane of the impactor for the second impact shall be at a distance of at least 300 mm from the first impact, the location of the first impact being free.

During the longitudinal impacts the extremities of the impactor shall not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.
For the longitudinal impact test the impactor shall be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal at the reference height of 445 mm.

For the longitudinal impact test the vehicle shall be aligned so that a point between the vehicle corners touches, but does not move, the impactor, the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle being perpendicular to plane A of the impactor.
In the longitudinal impact test the vehicle shall be impacted at a speed of 4 km/h +0.25/-0.
The corner impact test shall consist of an impact at one front corner and an impact at one rear corner with the vehicle at unladen weight.
The corner impact test shall consist of an impact at the other front corner and the other rear corner with the vehicle at laden test weight.
For the corner impact test the impactor shall be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal and at the reference height of 445 mm.
For the corner impact test the vehicle shall be aligned so that a corner of the vehicle touches the impactor without moving it.
In the corner impact test, plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
In the corner impact test, the point of first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).
In the corner impact test the vehicle shall be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0.
The protective devices and the mountings attaching them to the vehicle structure may be repaired or replaced between the tests.
condition: between tests

text: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.
condition: if the protective devices include self-restoring materials

text: A vehicle of the same type may be used for each test, if the manufacturer so requests.
condition: if the manufacturer so requests

text: If the manufacturer so requests, the technical service may allow the same vehicle as used for tests prescribed by other Regulations (including tests capable of affecting its structure) to be used for the tests of this Regulation.
condition: if the manufacturer so requests

text: If the test has been carried out at an impact speed or impact mass exceeding those indicated in paragraphs 2.7.5 and 2.8.4 and the vehicle has satisfied the prescribed conditions, the test is considered satisfactory.
condition: if impact speed or mass exceeds the prescribed values

text: The instrument used to record the impact speed shall be accurate to within one per cent.
Other equivalent test methods are permitted only provided that the conditions referred to in this Regulation can be observed and that their equivalence can be demonstrated.
condition: if an equivalent test method is used
